punchline: The ban held harmless devices at the same gate as harmful ones.
thirty_sec: On 26 June 1968 the FCC ruled in the Carterfone case that AT&T's ban on outside devices was unreasonable because it covered harmless as well as harmful ones; devices that did no harm could now be attached.
question: Which rule of yours looks only at who is asking, never at the harm?
key_contrast: The burden of proof moved from the newcomer to the one who bans.
